project: Heart Disease Risk Detection Using Machine Learning

target.name: num
target.description: Original angiographic disease status (`num`): 0 = less than 50% diameter narrowing, 1–4 = greater than 50% narrowing in at least one major vessel. For modelling, values 1–4 are combined into a binary 'disease indicated' class.

features.label: Age
features.description: Age of the patient at the time of the examination.

features.label: Sex
features.description: Recorded biological sex (UCI coding: 0 = female, 1 = male).

features.label: Resting blood pressure
features.description: Resting systolic blood pressure on admission to hospital.

features.label: Serum cholesterol
features.description: Total serum cholesterol measured at the examination.

features.label: Fasting blood sugar
features.description: Whether fasting blood sugar exceeds 120 mg/dL (UCI coding: 1 = true).

features.label: Maximum heart rate
features.description: Maximum heart rate achieved during the exercise stress test.

features.label: Chest pain type
features.description: Chest pain category recorded at presentation (original UCI 1–4 coding).

features.label: Resting ECG
features.description: Resting electrocardiographic findings (UCI coding: 0 = normal, 1 = ST-T abnormality, 2 = probable/definite LVH).

features.label: Exercise-induced angina
features.description: Whether exercise provoked angina during the stress test.

features.label: ST depression (oldpeak)
features.description: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest, measured on the ECG.

features.label: ST segment slope
features.description: Slope of the peak-exercise ST segment (UCI coding: 1 = upsloping, 2 = flat, 3 = downsloping).

features.label: Major vessels coloured
features.description: Number of major vessels (0–3) coloured by fluoroscopy. May be left unrecorded; the training pipeline imputes the median.

features.label: Thalassemia scan
features.description: Thallium stress-test result (original UCI coding: 3 = normal, 6 = fixed defect, 7 = reversible defect). May be left unrecorded; the training pipeline imputes the most frequent value.

preprocessing.categorical_imputation: most frequent (fitted on training folds only)
preprocessing.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'); one reference level per feature

encoding_notes: Uses the original UCI Cleveland codes, not the modified Kaggle encodings: cp 1–4, restecg 0–2, slope 1–3, thal 3/6/7, and num 0–4 mapped to binary via num > 0.
